GP services are quite good but the turnover is high so it is impossible to keep any kind of rapport.

Appointment waiting times are very long. Administrative tasks are a nightmare. There has for the last months been a 133second message you are forced to listen to when phoning the GP before it actually rings just talking unnecessary rubbish to try to put you off from calling.

There is a callback request service which is novel and a great idea though, hopefully this continues.

Finally the vast majority of appointments they want to go through the PATCHES electronic system, but there are two problems with this. Firstly, for no obvious reason at all you can only submit your issue on there during GP opening hours. Not great for anyone working full time.

Secondly, all the responses go through there rather than an email/text which means you have to answer 4 or so security questions and log in to an external site requiring internet every time you want to check what message they sent you. Ridiculous
